title: lastrea goeringiana
intro: Lastrea goeringiana, commonly known as the Goering's fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea goeringiana are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain and swelling, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
